title: Evensong
extract:
Evensong is  Jade's signature bow and counterpart to Stalker's  Dread. Shots apply empowered  Puncture status effects and kills grant increased Multishot.

Characteristics
This weapon deals primarily  Slash damage.
Fully charged shots explode in a 4 meter radius on impact with a surface or enemy.
Charged shot projectiles cannot benefit from Punch Through, and will explode on the first surface or enemy hit.
Initial hit and explosion apply status separately.
Explosion does not need direct line of sight to deal damage and will penetrate walls.
Can benefit from  Firestorm ( Primed) and  Cautious Shot.
Can equip the bow-exclusive  Thunderbolt mod.
Fire rate mods apply double their bonuses.
Direct hits and explosion apply 7  Puncture status effects (bypassing the normal limit of 5), reducing enemy damage by 100% and increasing weapon Critical Chance that the victim receives by 35%.
Kills grant Evensong Devotion, increasing Multishot by 35% for 30 seconds to all allies within Affinity Range.
When combined with the effects of  Cantare, and  Harmony, all three buffs merge into Jade's Ensemble, which lasts 60 seconds and increases the multishot bonus to 70%.

Acquisition
Evensong's blueprint is obtained from Ascension on Brutus, Uranus, at a 5% drop rate.
Alternatively, the blueprints can also be purchased from Ordis in the Drifter's Camp for 300  Vestigial Motes, awarded from Ascension in quantities of 11-13 (16-18 on The Steel Path) from mission completion and 5-7 (8-10 on The Steel Path) from the optional Sisters of Parvos objective.

All drop rates data is obtained from DE's official drop tables stored on Module:DropTables/data.
See Mission Rewards#Standard Missions for definitions on reward table rotations.

Notes
Triggering Evensong Devotion while it is already active will refresh the duration.
Enemies killed with status effects inflicted by an Evensong arrow will trigger Evensong Devotion.
This includes enemies killed by damage-over-time status effects inflicted by the charged radial attack.
However, enemies killed by damage caused by area-of-effect status effects such as  Gas clouds will not trigger it.
Enemies that are usually capped at 4 stacks of a status, such as Acolytes and enemies with Overguard, will receive 5 stacks of  Puncture from Evensong.
Blast radius of the radial charged attack can be increased by using  Firestorm.
All enemies struck by the radial attack will be inflicted with 7 stacks of  Puncture.
A fully charged projectile will despawn on causing a radial explosion, even if it had punch-through.
 Thunderbolt's explosions will apply Evensong's Puncture passive to enemies it hits, enabling uncharged shots to apply Puncture status in a 10m radius, albeit with only a 30% chance of an explosion per projectile.
When Evensong is shot into  Zephyr's  Tornado, instead of  Puncture adding to the final critical chance of the weapon, it appears to get multiplied by critical chance mods.
The specter from Duality will not apply the 7 stacks of Puncture when hitting enemies with the Evensong.

Trivia
Evensong is a Christian church service that involves singing.
